senses.gloss: औत्पत्तिक mf(ई)n. (fr. उत्-पत्ति), relating to origin, inborn, original, natural, Lāṭy.; BhP. &c.; á priori
औत्पातिक mf(ई)n. astounding, portentous, prodigious, calamitous, MBh.; Ragh. &c.
औत्पातिक m. N. of the third act of the Mahānāṭaka.
औत्पात mfn. (fr. उत्-पात, g. ऋगयनादि, Pāṇ. iv, 3, 73), treating of or contained in a book which treats of portents, T.
औत्पाद mfn. (fr. उत्-पाद, g. ऋगयनादि, Pāṇ. v, 3, 73), knowing or studying a book on birth or production
contained in such a book, T.
औत्पुट mfn. (fr. उत्-पुट, g. संकलादि, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 75) = उत्पुटेन निर्वृत्त.
औत्पुटिक mfn. (fr. id. g. उत्सङ्गादि, Pāṇ. iv, 4, 15) = उत्पुटेन हारक.
